item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:00 HKT 23/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will continue to bring hot weather to the coast of southern China today. There will also be one or two showers over the region. A trough of low pressure is expected to affect southern China and edge closer to the coastal areas in the next couple of days. There will be more showers with thunderstorms over the region. Showers will be heavy in some areas. A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. Temperatures will fall slightly over the region. The easterly airstream is expected to moderate gradually early next week. There will still be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong.
